items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The interviewer addresses 'Briony' directly ('Get up, Briony. Go lay down.') but the interviewee never mentions Briony or describes a relationship with them.

ctx.x: Lacroix Marine Pierce. Marine. L-M-P. Get up, Briony. Go lay down. Go lay down, Briony.
And he recorded you as Lacroix Pierce, Jr., huh? M-hmm. Book 127, folio, 259, New Orleans, March the 9th, 1904.
